_doc: A monster config for the art-free example: the Dried Corpse rebuilt on its own vanilla HD unit (classic token MM, donor mummy1). Every key is explained in docs/monster-sprite-to-3d.md, 'The monster config'. part_bone and shell_bone name the donor's spare bones the hand-built steps use (jaw: a rigid part; loin_cloth: the corpse shell). body.params.hd_cap false: this monster has no designed rigid part (s4_hdcap.py).
name: example_mummy
